title: de Mello Awake workflow input
description: A short audio source and immutable visual-style/duration policy. Runtime policy additionally allowlists audio_ref and performs redirect-aware SSRF checks for audio_url.

audio_url.description: HTTPS-only input. Loopback, private, link-local, multicast, reserved, credential-bearing, and redirect-escaping targets are rejected by runtime policy.

audio_ref.description: Server-owned allowlisted identifier, never a path or caller-selected object key.

duration_bounds.$comment: Runtime semantic validation requires max_seconds >= min_seconds. Accepted audio above max_seconds is trimmed; audio below min_seconds fails before image spend.
